1 · Intro

When to use it.

As an HCM you can see Social Security numbers, pay, addresses, leave, and disciplinary records. That access comes with a duty to protect it.

You complete the confidentiality and secure access agreement every year. This course covers what you are agreeing to.

Use this whenYou are completing your annual agreement, or you are unsure whether you may access, share, or save a piece of employee data.

2 · Walk through

Your responsibilities.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • The person number, not the SSN, is how you identify people in email and spreadsheets.
  • If your access shows people outside your area, report it; do not use it.
  • Open item: confirm where the Vanderbilt agreement lives, how to complete it, its due date, and where to report a data incident.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • FTC: Protecting Personal Information: A Guide for Business (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: How do I secure person records in HCM? (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1You can open any record in your area. When should you?

Q2A colleague asks you to email a list of employees with SSNs. What is the best response?

Q3You emailed a pay file to the wrong person. What do you do?

HCM Academy job aid · Start Here

Confidentiality and Secure Access Agreement (annual)

Use when: You are completing your annual agreement, or you are unsure whether you may access, share, or save a piece of employee data. · System: Process

  1. Look only at what you need for your job.
  2. Never share your login or let someone work under your account.
  3. Keep personal data in the system.
    • Use encrypted, approved channels when you must send it.
  4. Treat SSNs and birth dates as the most sensitive fields.
  5. Share only with people who have a business need.
  6. Report a suspected incident right away.

Watch-outs

  • The person number, not the SSN, is how you identify people in email and spreadsheets.
  • If your access shows people outside your area, report it; do not use it.
  • Open item: confirm where the Vanderbilt agreement lives, how to complete it, its due date, and where to report a data incident.
